scope: All voting House seats, separate nonvoting seats, and provisional incoming House members

CongressData.codebook_qualification: Current v3 codebook and the paper deposit have separate vintages; export only actual native columns.

findings_and_repairs.finding: The 360 incumbent election candidates were not the entire sitting House.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Build a separate Clerk-seat roster, qualify every occupant by stable Bioguide and dated state/House service, retain two explicit vacancies, and separate six nonvoting seats.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Core background gaps remained outside the candidate subset.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Extend the official directory and stable-ID sources to all 433 occupants; acquire Blair's Historian biography and Crenshaw's official career biography.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Recent service crosswalks omitted some returning members and nickname forms.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Qualify source-recorded aliases and full historical service crosswalks; recover six former members and Bob Onder. Preserve state, party and identity guards; reject ambiguity.

findings_and_repairs.finding: A similarly named Wikipedia article can identify the wrong person.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Follow actual district-roster links, not guessed article titles; retain uncertain birth-year literals and hold conflicting birth years. Add regression tests.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Provider winner flags and dated new-member articles are not certified final rosters.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Keep all 435 incoming seats and unresolved outcomes, retain independent provider clocks and Quorum's November 12 caveats, and do not manufacture a federal voting record for newcomers.

findings_and_repairs.finding: A source catalog and a current codebook do not establish acquired historical variable coverage.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Acquire the authors' licensed native CongressData deposit, verify its published checksum, measure its actual rows and columns, and preserve the source vintage and all native variables.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Religion and military-service coverage cannot be completed by treating proxies or omissions as facts.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Retain unknown/refused and no-disclosure statuses separately, record unsuccessful disclosure searches, and never turn military-source absence into nonservice.

invariants.full_release_verification: audits/publication.json records checkout tests, extracted offline replay and final archive receipts without an archive-hash cycle.

remaining_limitations: This is the pinned November 3 Clerk population, retrieved November 13, not a live November 14 membership claim.
Dated religion responses and historical CongressData variables are not verified current beliefs.
Incoming member calls remain provisional, with nine unresolved seats and incomplete individual newcomer traits.
Wikipedia individual-page rate limits and Inside Elections' HTTP 403 prevented further acquisition; the failures are preserved.
New background and campaign-extracted evidence remains descriptive/model-ineligible; frozen candidate-performance results and their original sample sizes are unchanged.
